task_title: Canonical Authorization Source Pinning & Storage Budget Reconciliation

issue_1_authorization_source_integrity.vulnerability_analyzed: STAGE6M_HARDENING_AUDIT_JSON environment variable override allowed arbitrary alternative audit JSON paths to be injected into the production CLI, reopening the file substitution risk eliminated in Task 7.5.1.
issue_1_authorization_source_integrity.remediation_action: Removed _AUDIT_ENV and os.environ.get('STAGE6M_HARDENING_AUDIT_JSON') entirely from scripts/materialize_stage6m_cohort3_audio.py. HARDENING_AUDIT_JSON now resolves unconditionally to the canonical repository governance JSON.
issue_1_authorization_source_integrity.in_process_testing_support: Preserved audit_json_path parameter on verify_*_authorization() helper functions and pytest monkeypatching for unit testing without environment variable or CLI leakage.

adversarial_tests_added.description: Adversary sets STAGE6M_HARDENING_AUDIT_JSON to fake audit claiming controlled_pilot_download=AUTHORIZED_BY_PROJECT_LEAD. Subprocess CLI strictly rejects acquisition under canonical governance (PILOT_COMPLETE_AND_VERIFIED) with PermissionError; destination directory remains empty.

Adversary sets STAGE6M_HARDENING_AUDIT_JSON to fake audit claiming full_audio_materialization=AUTHORIZED_BY_PROJECT_LEAD. Subprocess CLI strictly rejects acquisition under canonical governance (BLOCKED_PENDING_TASK_7_6_AUTHORIZATION) with PermissionError; destination directory remains empty.

issue_1_authorization_source_integrity.verdict: PASS — Fail-closed authorization strictly pinned to canonical governance record; environment variable substitution eliminated.

issue_2_storage_budget_reconciliation.reconciliation_rationale: Reconciled the raw audio allocation from 1.80 GB to 2.00 GB to properly encompass the 1.87 GB conservative 3-sigma planning envelope (18,975 * [mean + 3*std_dev]). Total operational headroom budget updated to 3.05 GB.

host_filesystem_capacity.historical_capacity_evidence_notice: The recorded 22.02 GB measurement represents historical capacity evidence as of the measurement timestamp, not an operational guarantee of available free space when eventual materialization begins; host storage must be re-checked prior to physical download in Task 7.7.

issue_2_storage_budget_reconciliation.verdict: PASS — Storage budget reconciled to 3.05 GB with 7.22x operational headroom on recorded capacity.
